groups.contract: Route, graph distance and hybrid coordinate operations
groups.disposition: Complete P16 body and full actual PR comparison consumed. Geographic encode/decode uses WGS84; explicit abstract E7 preserves full signed i32 lattice. Abstract decoded coordinates are finite and bounded by i32 E7 representation, so Euclidean difference/square cannot overflow f64 on that admitted path. Geographic haversine checks finiteness and clamps rounding drift to [0,1]. Do not impose WGS84 on abstract coordinates. Dijkstra only replaces strictly shorter nonnegative distances and ends at the first non-source settlement; saturating distance/time arithmetic can collapse represented extreme distances, but actual huge graph reachability/capacity is not established. No ordinary overflow promoted.

groups.contract: Complete route admission and departure/return preservation
groups.disposition: Points2..512, spans1..256, aggregate distance/minutes1..2M; exact positive continuous spans, widened sum of five u16 terrain weights equals1000, urban0, multiplier<=1000/check<=5000. Segment geometry 1..100000 checked-added, endpoints within500m, physical tolerance route.distance/20+250 safely bounded, minimum duration safe under route bounds. Weather version, interval divisibility, bps and Clear/intensity relation checked. Return leg independently revalidated by constructing an ordinary route without nested return payload. Departure/redirect weather intervals rechecked against synchronized actual minute. No new operation defect; downstream raw JourneyRoutePlan storage must use these admission boundaries, acceptance is source proof only, not test execution.
